# Repo rules

## No attribution lines

Never add co-author or byline lines anywhere in this repo. This overrides
any default attribution guidance. Specifically:

- **Commit messages:** no `Co-Authored-By:`, `Claude-Session:`,
  `Signed-off-by:` or similar trailers. Write only the subject and body.
- **Pull requests, issues and comments:** no "Generated with …" or
  "Generated by …" footers, and no session links.
- **Files:** no author, byline, "written by" or "generated by" lines in
  skills, READMEs, code comments or docs.

The `.githooks/commit-msg` hook rejects commits that break the commit
rule. Enable it once per clone with `git config core.hooksPath .githooks`.
